keys: No word yet on this one.
en: No word yet on this one.

keys: Keeps the trail dust out of your lungs.
en: Keeps the trail dust out of your lungs.
de: Hält den Staub der Straße aus deinen Lungen.

keys: Plain, well-worn clothes fit for the trail.
en: Plain, well-worn clothes fit for the trail.
de: Schlichte, abgetragene Kleidung für die Reise.

keys: A tin star pinned to the brim. Marks you as the law's helping hand.
en: A tin star pinned to the brim. Marks you as the law's helping hand.
de: Ein Blechstern am Rand. Kennzeichnet dich als Helfer des Gesetzes.

keys: Dust-worn leather, good for long rides.
en: Dust-worn leather, good for long rides.
de: Staubiges Leder, gut für lange Ritte.

keys: A hand-etched grip for your sidearm.
en: A hand-etched grip for your sidearm.
de: Ein handgravierte Griff für deine Seitenwaffe.

keys: A weathered tin star pinned to the brim.
en: A weathered tin star pinned to the brim.

keys: This item acts as a placeholder.
en: This item acts as a placeholder.

keys: Fits the revolver. The cylinder charges itself the moment the last round is spent, and a reload pressed while the dial crosses the marked notch slams it home instantly.
en: Fits the revolver. The cylinder charges itself the moment the last round is spent, and a reload pressed while the dial crosses the marked notch slams it home instantly.
de: Passt zum Revolver. Die Trommel lädt sich selbst, sobald die letzte Patrone verschossen ist, und ein Nachladen genau auf der markierten Kerbe füllt sie sofort.

keys: Welcome to the bank. Safest vault this side of the territory.
en: Welcome to the bank. Safest vault this side of the territory.
de: Willkommen in der Bank. Der sicherste Tresor weit und breit.

keys: No safe-deposit boxes or loans just yet - we're still setting up shop.
en: No safe-deposit boxes or loans just yet - we're still setting up shop.
de: Noch keine Schließfächer oder Kredite - wir richten uns noch ein.

keys: Come back once we're properly open for business.
en: Come back once we're properly open for business.
de: Komm wieder, sobald wir richtig geöffnet haben.

keys: Mail's running slow with the railway still finding its feet.
en: Mail's running slow with the railway still finding its feet.
de: Die Post kommt nur langsam, solange die Eisenbahn noch aufgebaut wird.

keys: Got a letter for you? Best hang onto it a while longer.
en: Got a letter for you? Best hang onto it a while longer.
de: Hast du einen Brief? Behalte ihn lieber noch eine Weile.

keys: Once that train's running regular, we'll have deliveries sorted.
en: Once that train's running regular, we'll have deliveries sorted.
de: Sobald der Zug regelmäßig fährt, kümmern wir uns um die Lieferungen.

keys: This town's been quiet lately. Aiming to keep it that way.
en: This town's been quiet lately. Aiming to keep it that way.
de: In dieser Stadt war es zuletzt ruhig. Das soll auch so bleiben.

keys: Got a fella cooling off in the cell over there. Rustled the wrong man's cattle.
en: Got a fella cooling off in the cell over there. Rustled the wrong man's cattle.
de: Dort drüben sitzt einer in der Zelle. Er hat die falschen Rinder gestohlen.

keys: You keep your nose clean and we won't have any trouble, partner.
en: You keep your nose clean and we won't have any trouble, partner.
de: Halte dich anständig und wir bekommen keinen Ärger, Partner.

keys: Line's still being laid down further out. No trains running just yet.
en: Line's still being laid down further out. No trains running just yet.
de: Die Gleise werden weiter draußen noch verlegt. Noch fahren keine Züge.

keys: Soon as the rails are done, you'll be able to ride clear across the territory.
en: Soon as the rails are done, you'll be able to ride clear across the territory.
de: Sobald die Gleise fertig sind, kannst du durch das ganze Gebiet fahren.

keys: Patience, partner. Good things take time.
en: Patience, partner. Good things take time.
de: Geduld, Partner. Gute Dinge brauchen Zeit.

keys: Bandits have been raiding the trade routes outside town.
en: Bandits have been raiding the trade routes outside town.
de: Banditen überfallen die Handelswege außerhalb der Stadt.

keys: Thin their numbers - bring me word that 5 of them are dealt with - and I'll make it worth your while.
en: Thin their numbers - bring me word that 5 of them are dealt with - and I'll make it worth your while.
de: Dezimier ihre Zahl - erledige 5 von ihnen - und ich werde dich dafür belohnen.

keys: Five bandits down. Roads are safer already.
en: Five bandits down. Roads are safer already.
de: Fünf Banditen erledigt. Die Straßen sind schon sicherer.

keys: Here, take this - a deputy hat, official as they come. Much obliged, partner.
en: Here, take this - a deputy hat, official as they come. Much obliged, partner.
de: Hier, nimm das - einen echten Stellvertreterhut. Vielen Dank, Partner.

keys: Howdy. Care to take a look at what I've got?
en: Howdy. Care to take a look at what I've got?
de: Hallo. Willst du dir ansehen, was ich habe?

keys: Permanently erase slot %d? This cannot be undone.
en: Permanently erase slot %d? This cannot be undone.
de: Platz %d endgültig löschen? Das kann nicht rückgängig gemacht werden.
Sie bis zu ihrem Bau verfolgen

keys: A rancher on the edge of town is losing cattle in the night. He swears what is taking them is no wolf and no rustler, and he wants it dealt with before the herd is gone.
en: A rancher on the edge of town is losing cattle in the night. He swears what is taking them is no wolf and no rustler, and he wants it dealt with before the herd is gone.
de: Einem Rancher am Rand der Stadt verschwindet nachts das Vieh. Er schwört, dass weder Wolf noch Viehdieb dahintersteckt, und will die Sache erledigt haben, bevor die Herde weg ist.

keys: Hutch says something has been at his herd. Ride out to his place on the edge of town and see it for yourself.
en: Hutch says something has been at his herd. Ride out to his place on the edge of town and see it for yourself.
de: Hutch sagt, etwas sei an seiner Herde gewesen. Reite zu seinem Hof am Rand der Stadt und sieh es dir selbst an.

keys: There is an old shaman living a hard ride out past the plains, said to know every creature that walks this country by name.
en: There is an old shaman living a hard ride out past the plains, said to know every creature that walks this country by name.
de: Jenseits der Ebenen lebt ein alter Schamane, der jede Kreatur dieses Landes beim Namen kennen soll.

keys: Follow it back to whatever ground it has left and finish the job.
en: Follow it back to whatever ground it has left and finish the job.
de: Folge ihr zu dem Boden, der ihr geblieben ist, und bring es zu Ende.

keys: A restless spirit has been seen whipping up sandstorms at the edge of the plains, burying travelers' camps overnight. Locals want it put down before the dunes swallow the road entirely.
en: A restless spirit has been seen whipping up sandstorms at the edge of the plains, burying travelers' camps overnight. Locals want it put down before the dunes swallow the road entirely.
de: Ein ruheloser Geist peitscht am Rand der Ebenen Sandstürme auf und begräbt über Nacht die Lager der Reisenden. Die Einheimischen wollen ihn erledigt sehen, bevor die Dünen die Straße ganz verschlucken.

keys: Come in, son. Doors stay open - not much left in here worth locking up.
en: Come in, son. Doors stay open - not much left in here worth locking up.
de: Komm rein, mein Sohn. Die Türen bleiben offen - hier drin ist kaum noch etwas abschließenswert.

keys: Folks bring me stranger tales every month. Lights out on the flats, cattle gone quiet.
en: Folks bring me stranger tales every month. Lights out on the flats, cattle gone quiet.
de: Die Leute bringen mir jeden Monat seltsamere Geschichten. Lichter draußen in der Ebene, Vieh, das verstummt.

keys: I say a word over each of them and hope that is enough. It generally is not.
en: I say a word over each of them and hope that is enough. It generally is not.
de: Ich spreche über jede ein Gebet und hoffe, dass es genügt. Meistens tut es das nicht.

keys: Sit a while if you need to. The Lord keeps longer hours than the bank does.
en: Sit a while if you need to. The Lord keeps longer hours than the bank does.
de: Setz dich ruhig eine Weile. Der Herrgott hat länger geöffnet als die Bank.

keys: Ticket? I'd sell you one, but I've nothing to put you on.
en: Ticket? I'd sell you one, but I've nothing to put you on.
de: Eine Fahrkarte? Ich würde dir eine verkaufen, nur habe ich nichts, worauf du steigen könntest.

keys: Line's laid as far as the cut and no further. Crews keep walking off the job.
en: Line's laid as far as the cut and no further. Crews keep walking off the job.
de: Die Strecke liegt bis zum Einschnitt und keinen Meter weiter. Die Trupps laufen uns dauernd davon.

keys: They say the desert doesn't care to be dug through. I say they're behind schedule.
en: They say the desert doesn't care to be dug through. I say they're behind schedule.
de: Sie sagen, die Wüste lasse sich nicht gern durchgraben. Ich sage, sie sind im Verzug.

keys: Come back when there's smoke on that horizon and I'll see you aboard.
en: Come back when there's smoke on that horizon and I'll see you aboard.
de: Komm wieder, wenn am Horizont Rauch steht, dann bringe ich dich an Bord.

keys: Door sticks - you have to lift it. Sit yourself down, there's coffee still warm.
en: Door sticks - you have to lift it. Sit yourself down, there's coffee still warm.
de: Die Tür klemmt - du musst sie anheben. Setz dich, es ist noch Kaffee warm.

keys: We came out for the cheap land and got it. Nobody thought to mention what was already living on it.
en: We came out for the cheap land and got it. Nobody thought to mention what was already living on it.
de: Wir sind wegen des billigen Landes hergekommen und haben es bekommen. Niemand hielt es für nötig zu erwähnen, was darauf schon lebte.

keys: Our fence line's a mile further out than it was two summers back. Hutch reckons that's why his cattle won't settle.
en: Our fence line's a mile further out than it was two summers back. Hutch reckons that's why his cattle won't settle.
de: Unser Zaun steht eine Meile weiter draußen als vor zwei Sommern. Hutch meint, deshalb kommt sein Vieh nicht zur Ruhe.

keys: My boy leaves a bowl of milk on the step some nights. I've stopped telling him not to.
en: My boy leaves a bowl of milk on the step some nights. I've stopped telling him not to.
de: Mein Junge stellt manche Nacht eine Schale Milch vor die Tür. Ich sage ihm nicht mehr, dass er es lassen soll.

keys: Ride back to town? Whatever you are in the middle of out here starts over the next time you take it on.
en: Ride back to town? Whatever you are in the middle of out here starts over the next time you take it on.
de: Zurück in die Stadt reiten? Was du hier draußen angefangen hast, beginnt von vorn, wenn du es das nächste Mal angehst.

keys: Leave for the main menu? Your game is saved first, and you pick this playthrough back up in town.
en: Leave for the main menu? Your game is saved first, and you pick this playthrough back up in town.
de: Zum Hauptmenü zurückkehren? Dein Spiel wird vorher gespeichert, und du steigst in der Stadt wieder ein.
